why: A unit no parent holds that hands out a function (a closure, an object's methods) or calls the callback it is handed gets a test from its calls (exec/new-test.mjs handedBody, design/w9am-handed-functions.md): the test binds what the unit returned and calls each handed-out function on the arguments lean drew by its declared parameter types, in lean's order, and asserts what lean saw; a callback is a vi.fn() answering what lean's fake answered, its calls asserted. The record's own checks are tests/new-unit-test.mjs; the pair keeps the family's verdict, NEW and never PASS (design/new-units.md).
